title: The Integrated Transport Centre launches “DUNE” platform for smart planning and AI-powered decision-making
summary: As part of the Livability and Investment Exhibition

Integrated Transport Centre (Abu Dhabi Mobility) booth at LIVEX 2026. Image Courtesy: ITC

As part of the Livability and Investment Exhibition

Press Release

Abu Dhabi – The Integrated Transport Centre (Abu Dhabi Mobility), an affiliate of the Department of Municipalities and Transport, has launched the “DUNE” smart platform during its participation in the Livability and Investment Exhibition (LIVEX 2026). The platform leverages Agentic AI technologies and the Strategic Transport Evaluation and Analysis Modelling (STEAM+) system to support transport planning, anticipate future mobility needs, and enhance data-driven decision-making.

The platform provides an integrated digital environment that combines artificial intelligence, data analytics, transport models, and advanced simulation capabilities, enabling different planning options to be studied and their potential impacts assessed. This supports the development of transport projects and mobility-related policies across the Emirate of Abu Dhabi.

The DUNE platform enhances the efficiency of strategic planning processes by supporting the evaluation of public transport projects, analysis of infrastructure investments, assessment of urban development plans, and testing different policies and development options before implementation. This enables a more accurate understanding of their potential impacts and supports the development of more efficient and sustainable transport solutions.

The platform also supports greater integration between transport and urban planning by bringing analytical and modelling tools together within a unified system. This enables future projects and investments to be aligned with the requirements of urban growth across the Emirate of Abu Dhabi, while supporting the development of more effective policies and projects that respond to future needs.

Eng Abdulla Hamad AlEryani, Acting Executive Director of the Planning and Strategic Affairs Sector at the Integrated Transport Centre, said: "The development of the DUNE platform reflects Abu Dhabi’s commitment to leveraging advanced technologies and artificial intelligence to enhance the transport system by supporting data-driven planning and strengthening the ability to anticipate future opportunities and challenges. The platform represents an advanced tool for studying alternatives and evaluating different options, contributing to the development of more efficient and sustainable mobility projects and policies, while supporting the Emirate’s quality of life objectives and sustainable urban development goals".

The launch of the DUNE platform reflects the Integrated Transport Centre’s ongoing efforts to leverage artificial intelligence and advanced analytical technologies to support planning and decision-making, contributing to the development of more efficient projects and policies that are responsive to the Emirate’s future growth requirements.

About Integrated Transport Centre:

The Integrated Transport Centre (Abu Dhabi Mobility), affiliated with the Department of Municipalities and Transport, is the legislative, regulatory, and supervisory authority responsible for managing and developing the transport sector in the emirate of Abu Dhabi. It formulates policies and frameworks aimed at establishing a smart, safe, and integrated mobility system that supports the Emirate’s aspiration to be among the most advanced cities in the world.

The Centre oversees all land, maritime, and aviation transport activities, ensuring the integration of the mobility system in line with urban and population growth requirements. It also leverages the latest technologies, innovation solutions, and sustainability practices to meet future mobility needs, enhance service efficiency, improve quality of life, and redefine urban mobility standards by promoting sustainable transportation concepts.
